CVE-2026-120350.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in the Vaadin Rich Text Editor via an Unescaped Video Embed
CVE-2026-120350.description:
The Vaadin Rich Text Editor exports a video embed without escaping its value, and then parses the resulting HTML into live DOM. A value crafted to break out of the href attribute therefore runs script in the viewer's browser. An attacker who can edit shared content pastes a video embed carrying the payload, the delta is stored, and the script runs when any user opens the page, including in read only mode.

Only content persisted through asDelta() is affected. The default HTML value, set and read through setValue and getValue, is sanitized on the server with a safelist that has no iframe, so the embed does not survive that path. Vaadin 24 and older are not affected: they build the HTML value from the editor's own innerHTML, which the browser escapes.

Users of affected versions should apply the following mitigation or upgrade. Releases that have fixed this issue include:

CVE-2026-45354.title: Netatalk: Pre-auth DSI Protocol Desync via dsi_code/dsi_doff Union
CVE-2026-45354.description: Netatalk is a Free and Open Source file server suite for Unix-like operating systems. Prior to 4.4.3, libatalk/dsi/dsi_stream.c interprets the dsi_code and dsi_doff union field as a data offset for all DSI command types instead of limiting that interpretation to DSIWrite. An unauthenticated client can send a non-WRITE DSIFUNC_CMD packet with a nonzero dsi_code smaller than dsi_len, causing dsi_stream_receive to consume only the dsi_code number of payload bytes and leave attacker-controlled bytes in the readahead buffer. The residual bytes become the next DSI header, allowing protocol desynchronization that can close sessions, corrupt protocol state, or trigger an infinite-read denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 4.4.3.

CVE-2026-99508.title: media: ipu-bridge: Fix use-after-free in IVSC error path
CVE-2026-99508.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

media: ipu-bridge: Fix use-after-free in IVSC error path

ipu_bridge_get_ivsc_acpi_dev() returns an ACPI device with a reference
held. If no matching CSI device is found, ipu_bridge_check_ivsc_dev()
drops that reference before passing the device to dev_err(). Concurrent
CSI device and ACPI namespace removal can drop the other references,
making this the final put. dev_err() then reads the freed struct
acpi_device and its kobject name.

This was reproduced without kprobes by racing normal CSI platform-device
unregistration and ACPI configfs table removal against the production
ipu_bridge_init() entry. KASAN reported the final free through
device_release(), followed by invalid reads through _dev_err().

Emit the error message while the lookup reference is still held, then
drop the reference as before.

Source reproducers and vulnerable/fixed serial logs, with only the build
hostname redacted, are available…
